issues.description: Packetization complects buffering, pacing, and serialization in the transport
issues.detail: The transport now inspects payload types and accumulates a bytearray, but the serializer already owns 'what is a Vonage audio frame.' Splitting bytes by fixed size belongs in a small pure function (or the serializer), not entangled with _write_frame. As written, value (bytes), identity (buffer), and time (when to flush) are all complected in one method.

issues.description: fixed_audio_packet_size has no time semantics, only byte semantics
issues.detail: The name says 'packet size' but the real concept is a duration at a sample rate and width. Callers must compute 640 = 20ms * 16kHz * 2 bytes by hand. Make the value explicit: accept a duration plus rate, or document the invariant. Otherwise mismatches between vonage_sample_rate and packet size will silently produce wrong-duration frames.

issues.description: Buffer is never flushed on stream end; trailing audio is silently dropped
issues.detail: _audio_send_buffer holds a remainder smaller than packet_bytes. On disconnect or end-of-utterance there is no zero-pad-and-flush, no log, no signal. That is a place-oriented bug: mutable state outlives the values that produced it. Either pad-and-send on end-of-stream, or document that sub-packet tails are discarded by design.

issues.description: DTMF parsing guesses at two payload shapes instead of pinning the contract
issues.detail: `message.get('digit') or message.get('dtmf', {}).get('digit')` is easy-not-simple: it hides that the Vonage payload shape is unknown to the author. Pick one based on the spec, log loudly when the other appears, and remove the fallback once confirmed. Right now the code encodes uncertainty as behavior.

issues.description: Two stateful resamplers complect identity with what should be a pure transform
issues.detail: Input and output resamplers are long-lived mutable objects held on the serializer. For a stateless rate conversion this is fine, but their lifecycle is never reset on StartFrame or reconfigure. If sample_rate changes mid-session the resamplers carry stale state. Reset them in setup, or make resampling a pure call.

issues.description: Packetization logic is untested and lives only in transport runtime
issues.detail: The chunking loop is a pure function pretending to be a method. Extract `chunk_pcm(buffer: bytes, size: int) -> (list[bytes], bytes)` and unit-test it. That is the smaller pure-function core; the transport then only owns the send. This is the decomposition the diff is one step away from.

review.summary: The Vonage serializer itself is reasonably SIMPLE — values in, values out, with a clear protocol mapping. The FastAPIWebsocketTransport change is where concerns get COMPLECTED: a mutable send buffer, fixed-size chunking, interruption-driven clear, and serialize-and-send are all tangled into _write_frame. The packet size is expressed in bytes when the real concept is duration-at-a-rate, which is EASY-NOT-SIMPLE and will produce silent mismatches. Pull the chunking out as a pure function, name the time semantics, and decide explicitly what happens to the sub-packet remainder at end-of-stream.
